_about: The oldest NVIDIA Windows driver each CUDA major version runs on, by minor version compatibility: an application built with CUDA X.y runs on any driver from X.0's on. The one copy of the rule: agent/release/src/drivers.rs (setup's driver check, MIN_NVIDIA_DRIVER for our job image) and the control plane's CudaDrivers (matching a renter's own image to a host's driver) both read this file. WSL 2 uses the Windows driver.

majors.note: CUDA 11.x minor version compatibility: >=452.39 on Windows
CUDA 13.x needs the R580 branch or newer
